feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 28 November 2026 5:30am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

Southeast 5 to 7, veering west 5 or 6 mid afternoon, then decreasing southwest 4 or 5 for a time early tonight.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, building mainly moderate in the morning, occasionally touching rough in the northeast in the afternoon.


##Weather)##

Rain late morning until early evening.


##Visibility)##

Good, becoming moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 11°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

Southwest 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 for a time in the morning.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough in the morning.


##Weather)##

Showers in the morning.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 11°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Monday, 30 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Gale force winds.


##Wind)##

South-southwest 5 or 6, imminently increasing 7 or gale 8.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, imminently becoming mainly rough, occasionally very rough in the south.


##Weather)##

Rain imminently arriving.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tuesday, 1 December 2026##


##Warnings)##

Gale force winds at first. Strong winds until the afternoon.


##Wind)##

South-southwest 7 or gale 8, veering and decreasing west 4 or 5 by midday.


##State of sea)##

Rough or very rough, falling slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Rain clearing by midday.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor, becoming good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Wednesday, 2 December 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

West 4 or 5, occasionally 6 for a time.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 10°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
